title: Uruguayan Sweet Tart
description: A traditional Uruguayan dessert featuring a sweet, pillowy filling and a shortcrust pastry crust.

ingredients.name: candy pieces (such as butterscotch or caramel)

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and use a pastry blender to work it into a crumbly mixture.
Press the mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch tart pan.
Bake the crust for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the oat milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Pour the filling over the warm crust.
Bake the tart for an additional 25-30 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and sprinkle with candy pieces.
Allow the tart to cool completely before serving.
